name: spider-leap
comment: WP-2.3b. Stone platform y = 60 over -12..12 with a two-high wall; night (set_time 18000; mobs join at t=1). Player (id 0) at (5.5, 61, 0.5) facing -x, spider (id 1) at (-5.5, 61, 0.5), difficulty 1. EntitySpider.findPlayerToAttack (brightness < 0.5, no sight test), EntitySpider.attackEntity: between 2 and 6 blocks a 1-in-10 roll leaps on the ground (motion toward the target, motionY 0.4), else EntityMob's melee (strength 2); the player ends up against the wall, which the spider climbs (EntitySpider.isOnLadder = isCollidedHorizontally). The player's fields are not dumped (EntityPlayer.attackEntityFrom, WP-2.5); the run stops while the port's player is still alive. rng_state and the spider's entity_state every tick.
